system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, roll a Smarts Check to make armour for yourself from materials around you: 1-3 successes make armour for 1 slot, 4+ successes make armour for a 2nd slot as well. Also +1 Talent Die when repairing armour.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.46
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, roll a Smarts Check to make armour for yourself from materials around you: 1-3 successes make armour for 1 slot, 4+ successes make armour for a 2nd slot as well. Also +1 Talent Die when repairing armour.

automation.onSuccess: 1-3 successes: armour for 1 slot. 4+ successes: armour for 2 slots.

automation.note: Crafting needs materials from the environment. Add the armour as an item covering 1 slot (2 slots on 4+ successes); the Director sets anything else about it.
